Section 4 • \(\xi\)3D

4.7 Decomposition of the 2PCF

Taking the ensemble average of Eq. (3.34), the factors \(\mathcal{C}(\Lambda)\) do not depend on the realization \(s\) and exit the averages: \begin{align} \xi\!\left(\vec{x}_{\perp\alpha},\Lambda_\alpha; \vec{x}_{\perp\beta},\Lambda_\beta\right) &\equiv \Big\langle \delta^{(s)}(\vec{x}_{\perp\alpha},\,\Lambda_\alpha)\, \delta^{(s)}(\vec{x}_{\perp\beta},\,\Lambda_\beta) \Big\rangle_{\rm ens} = \frac{1}{1+\mathcal{C}(\Lambda_\alpha)} \frac{1}{1+\mathcal{C}(\Lambda_\beta)} \Bigg[ \underbrace{ \mathcal{C}(\Lambda_\alpha)\,\mathcal{C}(\Lambda_\beta) }_{\mathrm{order}\, 0} + \dots \notag \\ &\quad \underbrace{ -\,\mathcal{C}(\Lambda_\alpha)\, \cancelto{0}{\Big\langle\mathcal{S}_{1}^{(s)}(\vec{x}_{\perp\beta},\,\Lambda_\beta)\Big\rangle_{\rm ens}} -\,\mathcal{C}(\Lambda_\beta)\, \cancelto{0}{\Big\langle\mathcal{S}_1^{(s)}(\vec{x}_{\perp\alpha},\,\Lambda_\alpha)\Big\rangle_{\rm ens}} }_{\mathrm{order}\, 1} + \dots \notag \\ &\quad + \underbrace{ \sum_{n=2}^{L} \left( -\,\mathcal{C}(\Lambda_\alpha)\, \Big\langle\mathcal{S}_{n}^{(s)}(\vec{x}_{\perp\beta},\,\Lambda_\beta)\Big\rangle_{\rm ens} -\,\mathcal{C}(\Lambda_\beta)\, \Big\langle\mathcal{S}_n^{(s)}(\vec{x}_{\perp\alpha},\,\Lambda_\alpha)\Big\rangle_{\rm ens} \right) }_{\mathrm{``Extremal"\, components\, of\, orders}\, 2 \leq n \leq L} +\dots \notag \\ &\quad \underbrace{ \sum_{n=2}^{L} \left( \sum_{p=1}^{n-1} \Big\langle \mathcal{S}_p^{(s)}(\vec{x}_{\perp\alpha},\,\Lambda_\alpha)\, \mathcal{S}_{n-p}^{(s)}(\vec{x}_{\perp\beta},\,\Lambda_\beta) \Big\rangle_{\rm ens} \right) }_{\mathrm{``Mid"\, components\, of\, orders}\, 2 \leq n \leq L} +\dots \notag \\ &\quad + \underbrace{ \sum_{n=L+1}^{2L} \sum_{p=n-L}^{L} \Big\langle \mathcal{S}_p^{(s)}(\vec{x}_{\perp\alpha},\,\Lambda_\alpha)\, \mathcal{S}_{n-p}^{(s)}(\vec{x}_{\perp\beta},\,\Lambda_\beta) \Big\rangle_{\rm ens} }_{\textrm{orders } L+1\,\le\, n\,\le\, 2L} \Bigg], \tag{4.15} \end{align} where the order-1 terms vanish because \(\langle\mathcal{S}_1^{(s)}\rangle_{\rm ens}=\sum_{j=1}^{L}\langle\delta_j^{(s)}\rangle_{\rm ens}=0\) by Eq. (3.26). Collecting the one-point averages of the orders \(2\le n\le L\), their sums over \(n\) are \(\mathcal{C}\) itself, by Eq. (3.31): \begin{align} -\,\mathcal{C}(\Lambda_\alpha) \underbrace{ \sum_{n=2}^{L}\Big\langle\mathcal{S}_{n}^{(s)}(\vec{x}_{\perp\beta},\,\Lambda_\beta)\Big\rangle_{\rm ens} }_{\mathcal{C}(\Lambda_\beta)} -\,\mathcal{C}(\Lambda_\beta) \underbrace{ \sum_{n=2}^{L}\Big\langle\mathcal{S}_{n}^{(s)}(\vec{x}_{\perp\alpha},\,\Lambda_\alpha)\Big\rangle_{\rm ens} }_{\mathcal{C}(\Lambda_\alpha)} = -\,2\,\mathcal{C}(\Lambda_\alpha)\,\mathcal{C}(\Lambda_\beta), \notag \end{align} which, added to the order-0 term \(\mathcal{C}(\Lambda_\alpha)\,\mathcal{C}(\Lambda_\beta)\), leaves \(-\,\mathcal{C}(\Lambda_\alpha)\,\mathcal{C}(\Lambda_\beta)\). The total 2PCF is therefore \begin{align} \xi\!\left(\vec{x}_{\perp\alpha},\Lambda_\alpha; \vec{x}_{\perp\beta},\Lambda_\beta\right) &= \frac{1}{1+\mathcal{C}(\Lambda_\alpha)} \frac{1}{1+\mathcal{C}(\Lambda_\beta)} \Bigg[ -\,\mathcal{C}(\Lambda_\alpha)\,\mathcal{C}(\Lambda_\beta) + \underbrace{ \sum_{n=2}^{L} \sum_{p=1}^{n-1} \Big\langle \mathcal{S}_p^{(s)}(\vec{x}_{\perp\alpha},\,\Lambda_\alpha)\, \mathcal{S}_{n-p}^{(s)}(\vec{x}_{\perp\beta},\,\Lambda_\beta) \Big\rangle_{\rm ens} }_{\mathrm{orders}\, 2 \leq n \leq L} \notag \\ &\qquad + \underbrace{ \sum_{n=L+1}^{2L} \sum_{p=n-L}^{L} \Big\langle \mathcal{S}_p^{(s)}(\vec{x}_{\perp\alpha},\,\Lambda_\alpha)\, \mathcal{S}_{n-p}^{(s)}(\vec{x}_{\perp\beta},\,\Lambda_\beta) \Big\rangle_{\rm ens} }_{\textrm{orders } L+1\,\le\, n\,\le\, 2L} \Bigg]. \tag{4.16} \end{align}

Computing explicitly the second order term only we find that: \begin{align} \Xi^{(2)}&\!\left(\vec{x}_{\perp\alpha},\Lambda_\alpha; \vec{x}_{\perp\beta},\Lambda_\beta\right) \coloneqq \Big\langle \mathcal{S}_1^{(s)}(\vec{x}_{\perp\alpha},\,\Lambda_\alpha) \, \mathcal{S}_1^{(s)}(\vec{x}_{\perp\beta},\,\Lambda_\beta) \Big\rangle_{\rm ens} = \Big\langle \left( \sum_{i=1}^{L} \delta_{i}^{(s)}\!\left(\vec{x}_{\perp\alpha},\Lambda_\alpha\right) \right) \left( \sum_{j=1}^{L} \delta_{j}^{(s)}\!\left(\vec{x}_{\perp\beta},\Lambda_\beta\right) \right) \Big\rangle_{\rm ens} = \notag \\ &= \sum_{i=1}^{L}\sum_{j=1}^{L} \Big\langle \delta_{i}^{(s)}\!\left(\vec{x}_{\perp\alpha},\Lambda_\alpha\right)\, \delta_{j}^{(s)}\!\left(\vec{x}_{\perp\beta},\Lambda_\beta\right) \Big\rangle_{\rm ens} = \sum_{i=1}^{L}\sum_{j=1}^{L} \xi_{ij}\!\left(\vec{x}_{\perp\alpha},\Lambda_\alpha ; \vec{x}_{\perp\beta},\Lambda_\beta\right) = \notag \\ &= \underbrace{ \sum_{i=1}^{L} \xi_{ii}\!\left(\vec{x}_{\perp\alpha},\Lambda_\alpha ; \vec{x}_{\perp\beta},\Lambda_\beta\right) }_{\textrm{autos } (i=j)} + \underbrace{ \sum_{1\le i<j\le L} \Big[ \xi_{ij}\!\left(\vec{x}_{\perp\alpha},\Lambda_\alpha ; \vec{x}_{\perp\beta},\Lambda_\beta\right) + \xi_{ji}\!\left(\vec{x}_{\perp\alpha},\Lambda_\alpha ; \vec{x}_{\perp\beta},\Lambda_\beta\right) \Big] }_{\textrm{crosses } (i\neq j)}, \tag{4.17} \end{align}

Hence, substituting this result in Eq. (4.16), the total 2PCF truncated up to order-2 can be written as \begin{align} \xi&\!\left(\vec{x}_{\perp\alpha},\Lambda_\alpha; \vec{x}_{\perp\beta},\Lambda_\beta\right) = \frac{1}{1+\mathcal{C}(\Lambda_\alpha)} \frac{1}{1+\mathcal{C}(\Lambda_\beta)} \Bigg[ -\,\mathcal{C}(\Lambda_\alpha)\,\mathcal{C}(\Lambda_\beta) +\dots \notag \\ & \dots + \sum_{i=1}^{L} \xi_{ii}\!\left(\vec{x}_{\perp\alpha},\Lambda_\alpha ; \vec{x}_{\perp\beta},\Lambda_\beta\right) + \sum_{1\le i<j\le L} \Big[ \xi_{ij}\!\left(\vec{x}_{\perp\alpha},\Lambda_\alpha ; \vec{x}_{\perp\beta},\Lambda_\beta\right) + \xi_{ji}\!\left(\vec{x}_{\perp\alpha},\Lambda_\alpha ; \vec{x}_{\perp\beta},\Lambda_\beta\right) \Big] +\dots \notag \\ & \dots + \sum_{n=3}^{L} \Xi^{(n)}\!\left(\vec{x}_{\perp\alpha},\Lambda_\alpha ; \vec{x}_{\perp\beta},\Lambda_\beta\right) \Bigg]. \tag{4.18} \end{align}

Applying Eq. (4.13) to the above, we can write the 2PCF as a function of the transverse and spectral separations only: \begin{align} \xi&\!\left( \vec{r}_{\perp},\Delta \right) = \frac{1}{(1+\mathcal{C}(\Lambda))^2} \Bigg[ -\,\mathcal{C}(\Lambda)^2 + \sum_{i=1}^{L} \xi_{ii}\!\left( \vec{r}_{\perp},\Delta \right) + \sum_{1\le i<j\le L} \Big[ \xi_{ij}\!\left( \vec{r}_{\perp},\Delta \right) + \xi_{ji}\!\left( \vec{r}_{\perp},\Delta \right) \Big] +\dots \Bigg]. \tag{4.19} \end{align}
